about: R as a cut-in cinematic and the ult form's warps (lane U, 10-19). Dex 10-16 / 10-19: the call at its original speed; then during the flurry she disappears: she BECOMES the slashes that slash the letter into existence (hundreds of them, each carving a piece, ~3 s or more; the letter ABSOLUTELY HUGE, a nuke; it matches her R line 一筆――天を断つ: 断 or 天); the slashes stop a moment (a beat of stillness); then she dives straight down from above, a vertical blur, and destroys everything: a nuke (a white / orange / red first flash engulfed by her blue flames, a huge eruption); the dust clears on the ult form; control back after the nuke. The form stands still-ish on one frame, then warps position to position summoning ghost blades. Ticks at 60 a second, distances in H (96 world px; she is 0.88 H). feel.json's ult block keeps the gameplay numbers (impact radius / damage / knockback, the form's length, cooldown, damage multiplier, the ghost hit); its R timings (callTicks .. revealTicks, riseTicks, zoomOut) are superseded by this file. ult.ts reads it; ultdraw.ts draws the stand-ins (clearly temporary until the FX v2 loop's effects, lanes/fx/v2/built/, and lane A's r_* drawings land).

clips.about: Length of the call and the reveal when their drawing is not in yet (the white box plays the same timeline); with a drawing they last exactly their clip, played 1:1 (the call at its original speed). From lane A's picks (lanes/anim/moves/<slot>/make.py). r_flurry plays only up to the storm beat (she crouches, bursts into ash, gone); the rest of the flurry is the slashes.

beats.about: Moments inside the clips as [source frame of the H3 take, clip tick]: anim.json frames carry `src` (kit v1.4) and the beat lands on the first drawing at or past it; without src the clip tick scales with the clip's length.

letter.about: The letter she carves (a stand-in for the FX v2 loop's): which character (断 or 天, Dex 10-19; strokes in ult.ts LETTERS), its box (`size` H square, its bottom `low` H above the floor, its near edge `ahead` H in front of her), the slash storm (`slashes` cuts over `ticks`, each carving a piece of a stroke; `pieces` of them carve new pieces, the rest re-cut; the last one the long closing cut), the brush's thickness (a share of the box), how far above the letter's top she hangs before the dive. Never mirrored: facing left it moves to her left, the strokes stay as written.

camera.about: The shots: world x at the frame's centre, world y on the anchor row (the anchor is that row's share of the frame's height). Zooms stay within the painted levels (2 = the close band) so the world stays crisp; the letter's pull-out goes down to 0.42 and the nuke's to 0.36 (lane C 10-19: below 1 she and her effects reduce onto her own grid). The call: a cut-in close on her, pushing in to the BOOM, craning up with the fire, settling as she coils. The flurry: a hard cut wide onto the letter, pulling out as it is carved. The stop: dead still. The dive: a push down after her onto the crater. The impact: the pull-out on the nuke. The reveal: back in on her. Reduced motion: hard cuts between held levels (2 for the call, 1 for the rest), no moves.

cues.about: Sound cue ids for lane D (sound.ts maps an id to its files; an id with no file is silent), fired on these beats: press (the cut-in), line (her R call, normal register: 一筆――天を断つ), boom (the bass hit as the fire line ignites), fire (the curtain's roar), draw (the sword), vanish (she bursts into ash), slash (every 6th slash of the storm: a dense roll, not hundreds of files), last (the closing cut: a bass hit), hush (the stop: dead silence, everything ducks out until dive), dive (the dive's whoosh), impact (the nuke: the biggest bass hit), rumble (the eruption's long tail), reveal (the dust clears), lineUlt (her ult-register line on the reveal pose); the form: warp, blade (a ghost blade summoned), cut (it strikes).

form.about: The ult form (Dex 10-19): a killing machine standing still-ish on one frame (uf_idle holds one drawing), then warping position to position, summoning ghost blades. Each M1 of the form's chain warps her (a blink: gone here, there) to a spot around the target before it swings: [ahead of the target (H, toward her side), up (H)], `cross` = the other side of it (she turns back to it). The target is a foe within reach ahead (the court's champion), else a point ahead that moves on with her. Ghost blades: per chain step, how many, summoned `summon` ticks before the hit and striking `ghostDelay` (feel.json) after it, through the target.
